text:
sam: Nimbus wants a 3-week POC: streaming partial claim parses into their form, function/tool calls to an internal extractor, quick SOC2 answers, and a headline reserved price. Need a compact dev runbook + price blurb.

jenna: Stack check: Node frontend, Python workers, tiny Go adapter?

sam: Yep.

miguel: Minimal Node example for SSE + function_call + structured output:
```js
const s = client.stream({model:'redwood-large-v2', stream:true, structured_output:true, tools:[{name:'claim_extractor'}]});
s.on('function_call', async (call)=>{ const res = await fetch('/adapter/extract',{method:'POST', body:JSON.stringify({text:call.args.text})}); await s.resume({tool_result: await res.json()}); });
```
Prefer SSE for one-way form updates; websockets if they need bi-directional low-latency.

devon: Ops defaults for POC: batch_size=1, max_concurrency=4, prefix_kv_cache=true. If doc sizes >4k tokens enable KV caching. Use quantized runtime for latency-sensitive demos. Configure fallback to smaller-model to avoid hard failures.

priya: For procurement/SOC2 I need customer security contact, sample payloads (headers ok), retention requirements, and whether PII will be sent to hosted API. Recommend Redwood Private for PII. I can prefill the questionnaire once we have the contact.

elaine: Pricing sketch: short reserved bucket for 3 weeks ~ $6k for low-volume pilot (1-2 qps sustained) + overage at list. Offer a one-time POC discount (15-20%) subject to deal-desk. Audit/log retention add-ons priced separately.

sam: Action items: Jenna -> Postman + minimal snippets; Miguel -> final Node + Python samples; Devon -> ops runbook; Priya -> prefilled security Q; Elaine -> pricing/SOW blurb. Target: customer email in 24 hours. :thumbsup:

redwood-bot: Please tag with #poc-handovers when assets are ready so sales-ops can pick up the onboarding steps.

sam: Thanks all, will loop Nimbus once package is ready.
